title: Identification and Validation of Pyroptosis-Associated Gene Signature in Primary Sjogren's Syndrome.
authors: Dai, Yijun; Chen, Hanzhi; Zhou, Meng; Wu, Chenmin; Gao, Fei; Wang, Yingzheng; Yan, Qing; Li, Zuoan
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦原发性干燥综合征中焦亡相关基因标志物的鉴定与验证，属于纯疾病转录组与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pyroptosis, a form of programmed cell death, has been implicated in autoimmune diseases (ADs) pathogenesis. However, its role in primary Sjogren's syndrome (pSS) remains unclear. This study aims to identify pyroptosis-related gene (PRG) signatures in pSS. METHODS: Three datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database to analyze the gene expression profiles in pSS. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were intersected with PRGs to identify pyroptosis-related DEGs (PRDEGs). Functional enrichment was assessed using Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG). Key genes were identified using the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) and support vector machine (SVM) analyses. A diagnostic model was constructed using logistic regression. mRNA-microRNA (miRNA) and mRNA-transcription factor (TF) interaction networks were constructed. Immune cell infiltration (ICI) was analyzed using cell-type identification by estimating relative subsets of RNA transcripts (CIBERSORTs) and single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA). Experimental validation was performed in nonobese diabetic (NOD)/ShiLtj mice using reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), western blotting, and immunofluorescence and was further validated using immunofluorescence in pSS patient samples. RESULTS: A total of 489 DEGs were identified, of which 22 were pyroptosis-related. GO/KEGG analysis revealed enrichment in immune response regulation, pyroptosis, and the positive regulation of receptor signaling pathways. LASSO and SVM analyses identified eight key genes (CRTAC1, platelet-endothelial cell adhesion molecule-1 [PECAM1], IRF2, GZMA, IFI16, absent in melanoma 2 [AIM2], TNF, and macrophage-expressed gene 1 [MPEG1]), which were incorporated into a diagnostic model that demonstrated strong discriminatory performance in both combined and validation datasets. Experimental validation confirmed significant increased expressions of PECAM1, IFI16, AIM2, and MPEG1 in the salivary glands from both NOD mice and pSS patients. CONCLUSIONS: PECAM1, IFI16, AIM2, and MPEG1 were identified as PRG signatures and potential biomarkers in pSS, providing novel insights into pSS pathogenesis.
abstract_zh: 背景：细胞焦亡（pyroptosis）作为一种程序性细胞死亡形式，已被认为与自身免疫性疾病（ADs）的发病机制相关。然而，其在原发性干燥综合征（pSS）中的作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在识别pSS中与焦亡相关的基因（PRG）特征。方法：从基因表达综合数据库（GEO）获取三个数据集，分析pSS中的基因表达谱。将差异表达基因（DEGs）与PRGs取交集，以识别焦亡相关差异表达基因（PRDEGs）。使用基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）评估功能富集。通过最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）及支持向量机（SVM）分析识别关键基因。使用逻辑回归构建诊断模型。构建mRNA-微小RNA（miRNA）和mRNA-转录因子（TF）相互作用网络。通过估计RNA转录本的相对子集进行细胞类型鉴定（CIBERSORTs）和单样本基因集富集分析（ssGSEA）分析免疫细胞浸润（ICI）。在非肥胖糖尿病（NOD）/ShiLtj小鼠中使用逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）、蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光进行实验验证，并在pSS患者样本中通过免疫荧光进一步验证。结果：共识别出489个DEGs，其中22个与焦亡相关。GO/KEGG分析显示富集于免疫应答调节、焦亡及受体信号通路正调控。LASSO和SVM分析识别出八个关键基因（CRTAC1、血小板内皮细胞黏附分子-1 [PECAM1]、IRF2、GZMA、IFI16、黑色素瘤缺失因子2 [AIM2]、TNF和巨噬细胞表达基因1 [MPEG1]），这些基因被纳入诊断模型，在合并和验证数据集中均表现出较强的判别性能。实验验证确认PECAM1、IFI16、AIM2和MPEG1在NOD小鼠和pSS患者的唾液腺中表达显著增加。结论：PECAM1、IFI16、AIM2和MPEG1被识别为pSS中的PRG特征和潜在生物标志物，为pSS发病机制提供了新见解。
